references.title: Carl G. Hempel, “Studies in the Logic of Confirmation” (1945), Part I
references.support: Primary text for the equivalence condition and ravens example; relevant passages were read in the university-hosted PDF, not the complete paper.

references.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Confirmation
references.support: Scholarly reference discussion of Hempel’s instance-based theory, the ravens paradox, hypothetico-deductive approaches, and Bayesian responses; relevant sections were read, not the entire entry.

references.title: Jan Sprenger, “Hempel and the Paradoxes of Confirmation” (2008 manuscript)
references.support: Scholarly manuscript discussing background information, Good’s counterexamples, and assumptions in Bayesian responses; relevant passages were read, not the complete manuscript. Good’s original 1967 note was not consulted.

references.title: Peter B. M. Vranas, “Hempel’s Raven Paradox: A Lacuna in the Standard Bayesian Solution”
references.support: Published scholarly objection to an assumption in a standard Bayesian solution; the publisher abstract and bibliographic record were read, but the full article was not accessed.
